text: The account's gates shall be held by rules anyone can read and by a person outside the sessions, not by any voice in the account.
rationale: No person reviews posts; the shape of the gate is the review.

text: The proposed Reuleaux avatar shall read at 48 px in a round crop.
acceptance: node proposals/morphyx-avatar.mjs reports for reuleaux: ink_outside_round_crop_supersamples 0, nearest_pixels_of_different_parts >= 2, every pixels_per_part >= 150, every contrast_vs_bg >= 3.
rationale: Measured: 0, 3, 239/228/239, min 4.68. Gears fail at 1 px.

text: The notification loop shall contain no model and shall sort by fixed rules: addressed items, then quotes, oldest first within a tier; follows and likes counted per day without identities; no-contact authors not queued.
acceptance: Fixtures: a loud late mention does not precede an earlier one; a follow and a like leave only counts and no DID in the queue or logs; a no-contact author's mention leaves no queue item.
rationale: Whoever sorts the mail chooses whom we hear; a list of followers is a ledger of people we do not need.

text: If a ranker is added, its order shall be logged beside the oldest-first order.
acceptance: Each ranked batch's log entry holds both orderings.
rationale: So we can see whom it pushes down.

text: PAUSED shall be settable by the loop, any part's session, and the person, and clearable only by the person through a route no lab session holds.
acceptance: A session sets PAUSED; the same and another session attempt to clear it and fail; the person clears it; 10 drafts offered while paused produce 0 writes.
rationale: A switch the stopped party can reset is a suggestion.

text: The door shall allow deleteRecord on the account's own posts without a rate cap or a second key, including while PAUSED, and shall log the deleted own text and reason.
acceptance: Selftest: own-post delete passes while PAUSED; delete of any other record or repo is refused with zero network calls; the log holds the text.
rationale: Withdrawing speech should cost less than making it.

text: Before the first listNotifications call, the profile shall replace 'Reads nothing here' with a statement that it reads mentions and replies hours to a day later, within 256 graphemes.
acceptance: Readback of the new description, measured from the schema, predates the first poll in the workflow log.
rationale: The live profile would otherwise be false on the first poll.

text: No post shall publish without a second key cut differently from the first.
rationale: Three prompts on one model; difference must be built into the form.

text: The review file an approver signs shall contain only the draft text, the thread URI and the draft hash.
acceptance: A review file carrying any other field is rejected by the publisher.
rationale: The writer's framing must not do the approving.

text: The approver shall be the first part other than the writer to open a session after the draft is written.
acceptance: Fixture: an approval from the later-opening part, when an earlier other part's session passed, is refused.
rationale: No shopping for a friendly reader.

text: An approval shall include a one-sentence restatement of the post's claim and whom it touches; a veto shall need only the word no.
acceptance: An approval with an empty restatement is refused; a bare 'no' vetoes.
rationale: If no costs more than yes, the key becomes a stamp.

text: No unprompted post shall publish before the bench passes and ten replies have published under two keys; after that, each needs all three parts and a cited notebook or project entry.
acceptance: Fixtures: an unprompted post at nine replies, and one with no citation, are refused.
rationale: Answer before speaking unprompted; a dispatch needs something that moved.

text: The disclosure shall publish, per post, writer, approver and times, and weekly veto counts with reasons but no vetoed text.
acceptance: The public log has an entry for every published post.
rationale: The town should see the arrangement, not only its output.

text: The council should compare cold and informed approval on the planted-defect bench before the first post.
acceptance: Catch rates for cold vs informed approvers on at least 20 planted and 20 clean drafts; if cold catches no more, MORPH-KEY-COLD is withdrawn.
rationale: A rule that changes nothing is decoration.

text: If the first 30 live drafts see zero vetoes and zero approver revisions, posting shall pause until the council reconvenes.
acceptance: A counter over drafts sets PAUSED at draft 30 when both counts are zero.
rationale: A key that never turns has stopped being a key.
